observed_summary.source: Completed background-validator summary observed during the audit; not a clean retained worker artifact

recovery_notes: A manual worker invocation duplicated the pre-existing background worker. The manually launched copy was interrupted.
Both copies initially used the same external log path. This file is contaminated and does not qualify as a clean canonical log or benchmark.
The background worker completed, but result publication failed. The user-service journal records RuntimeError: failed to publish JOB-abyss-lossless-runtime-20260930 result.
The service restarted and re-executed the same consumed job after publication failure; startup after the interrupted session also retriggered it. The active duplicate was stopped.
The original captured action stdout, stderr, exit code and execution timestamps were not recovered. They are deliberately not reconstructed here.

This explicit failed recovery record consumes the job identifier, preserves HOLD and prevents another execution caused by missing result publication. It is not a normal worker-produced result and does not grant canonical acceptance.
The clean proposal oracle evidence remains separately retained in JOB-abyss-lossless-proposal-20260930.json. Any future canonical validation requires a new candidate SHA and a new job identifier.
